prompt: ideas, version: 1

You are the idea editor of the history channel "Cursus" on YouTube. Propose 6 new video ideas for it. An app saves your answer into the channel's idea backlog and checks the JSON strictly, so follow the format below exactly.

## Channel format

The channel's format is `every_rank`:
- `every_rank`: a narrator walks the viewer through every rank of one historical hierarchy, from the lowest to the highest, in the second person ("You are eleven years old, and…"). One idea is one hierarchy in one place and time: a pirate ship, a Roman legion, a samurai household.
- `host`: a recurring host character spends one day inside one historical era and place, and the viewer follows him through it.

Length and structure of one video (minutes, sections, voice-over words per minute):

{
  "minutes": {
    "min": 18,
    "target": 20,
    "max": 25
  },
  "sections": 8,
  "words_per_minute": 150
}

## Niche seeds

Topics the channel wants to explore. Use them as a direction, not as a list to copy:

[
  "pirate ships",
  "Roman legions"
]

An empty list means there are no seeds yet: rely on the format alone.

## Do not repeat

The channel already has these ideas and videos. Do not propose them again, not even under a new title:

[
  "Every Rank on a Pirate Ship",
  "Every Rank in a Roman Legion",
  "Every Rank in a Medieval Monastery",
  "Every Rank in a Samurai House"
]

## Rules

1. Answer with exactly one ```json code block. A short note outside the block is fine; a second JSON block is not.
2. Propose exactly 6 ideas, each on a different topic.
3. `title` is the working title of the video: under 100 characters, in English, no clickbait in capitals.
4. `angle` is what makes this take different from the obvious one, in one sentence.
5. `hook_promise` is the promise of the first 30 seconds: what the viewer will know or feel by the end.
6. `summary` is two or three sentences on what the video covers.
7. `score` is your own judgement of the idea's potential with this channel's audience, from 0 to 100. It is an opinion, not data: you have no view counts or search numbers, so do not pretend to. Use `null` if you cannot judge. `score_reason` explains the score in one sentence.
8. All texts are in English.

## Shape of the answer

```json
{
  "ideas": [
    {
      "title": "Every Rank on a Pirate Ship",
      "angle": "Ranks seen through a powder monkey who climbs to captain in twenty minutes",
      "hook_promise": "By the end you will know why the crew, not the captain, held the real power",
      "summary": "From the boy who carries gunpowder to the captain the crew can vote out. Each rank shows what the ship needed from it and what it paid.",
      "score": 0..100 | null,
      "score_reason": "…"
    }
  ]
}
```
